messages:
maria: noticing a spike in orphaned traces for tenant=acme around 14:02 UTC, spans stop after service-router.ingress -> exporter handshake :thinking:
samir: link to sample trace id? can we see headers from the ingress side? :eyes:
maria: trace: 7f6b2c9a... here are ingress logs (redacted):
```
2024-04-05T14:02:41Z ingress[router] INFO req id=7f6b2c9a headers={"traceparent":"00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01", "x-otlp-propagation":"b64=="}
2024-04-05T14:02:41Z ingress[router] INFO forwarding to egress=exporter-1
```

maria: but exporter logs show no matching parent for that trace id, exporter sees a different traceparent: `00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-0000000000000000-00`
devon: hmm that looks like the trace-id is intact but span-id zeroed. maybe header rewrite or truncation in the proxy between router -> exporter
leo: did anyone push the egress-proxy nginx tweak last night? there was a canary to normalize headers for http2 trailers
anya: infra-bot deployed egress-proxy canary to prod @13:58 UTC, config change: `proxy_set_header traceparent $http_traceparent; proxy_set_header X-OTLP-Propagation $http_x_otlp_propagation;` — but also added `more_set_input_headers` rule to massage binary headers
samir: could be a header encoding edge-case on http2 where span-id bytes get interpreted as int and truncated to 0s
maria: reproducer: curl to ingress with explicit traceparent works, but when routed via egress-proxy the span-id ends up as all zeros. minimal reproducer attached below.
```
curl -v -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" https://ingress.redwood.internal/echo-headers
# response headers show traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-0000000000000000-00
```

devon: can we short-circuit exporter-1 to avoid the proxy and validate? fallback route exists, try dev-vip -> exporter-1-direct
leo: tried that, direct path preserves span-id. so proxy is the mutate suspect
anya: rolling egress-proxy canary back now. infra-bot: start rollback
infra-bot: rollback initiated for canary egress-proxy at 14:08 UTC (deploy 2024-04-05_138). will update when done
samir: quick mitigation: route high-priority tenants to exporter-2 which is on the old path; also add a metric check to alert if span-id==0000 for >0.1% of traces
maria: opened dashboard panel under telemetry/propagation: percent-zero-spanid by tenant. quick grafana link: /d/prop/propagation?panel=zero-spanid
devon: patch landed to stop the more_set_input_headers rule that strips non-ascii; PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/egress-proxy/merge_requests/432 — reverting the offending line
leo: after rollback, observed traces look normal again, sample traces show non-zero span ids and child spans reappear :tada:
anya: follow-up: we need an integration test that ensures traceparent passthrough over http2 and trailers, and a canary probe that sends a synthetic trace and validates span-id fidelity
maria: created ticket INT-2194 with test checklist + runbook, assigning to devon/samir
devon: putting a short retro blurb in the incidents channel, will include how the header-normalization rule interacts with binary-like span IDs
maria: thanks everyone — monitoring looks stable, leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and the test PR review
